name: onepipeline-ui-judged-diff
//: The judged diff lint, a project of its own that no project depends on. Its key is every file in the workspace (`nx.json`'s `lint-llm-diff` default), and Nx marks a project affected by any file its targets' inputs name: on the crate's root project that key selected the crate, and through it the view and its journeys, for every change. Here it selects only this project. `just lint-llm-diff` runs it.
